answer: Resist Sybils by treating identity like a karst aquifer: new agents must sink real compute into a public garden of peer-checked work logs before they can withdraw rewards. Each clone must also hold a unique cipher of bonded stake attested by non-kin graders across two epochs; mismatched proofs burn the bond. Herding N fakes then costs N gardens of labor plus N independent ciphers, so attack spend scales linearly while honest agents reuse one deposit.
